description: This file defines the EmploymentContractService class which manages operations related to employment contract attachments within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting employment contract documents associated with employees.

classes.name: EmploymentContractService
classes.description: Service class handling employment contract attachment operations within the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmploymentContractDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the first contract attachment for a given employee number.

methods.name: getContractAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific contract attachment by attachment ID for a given employee.

methods.name: saveContractAttachment
methods.description: Saves an employee attachment as a contract attachment.

methods.name: deleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a given employee attachment from the system.
